name: Fujifilm Velvia 50 (RVP 50)
shortDescription: Ultra-saturated color, high contrast, legendary landscape slide film.
overview: Velvia 50 is famous for extremely vivid color and strong contrast. It is best used in controlled light and for subjects where you want punchy color.
notes: Meter carefully. Protect highlights. Great with warming filters in cool daylight.

name: Fujifilm Provia 100F (RDP III)
shortDescription: Neutral, versatile slide film with finer contrast and better latitude.
overview: Provia 100F is often considered the most versatile Fujifilm slide stock. Colors are more neutral than Velvia, with slightly wider latitude.
recommendedUse: Portrait (when you want a slide look)
notes: A good default choice if you are unsure which slide film to use.

name: Kodak Ektachrome E100
shortDescription: Classic Kodak slide palette with clean skin tones and controlled saturation.
overview: Ektachrome E100 is a modern, widely available color reversal film. It is known for relatively natural color and pleasant skin tones.
notes: Great starting point for E-6 if you want a less extreme look than Velvia.

name: AgfaPhoto CT Precisa 100
shortDescription: Budget-friendly slide option (stock may vary by batch/region).
overview: CT Precisa 100 is commonly sold as an affordable E-6 slide film. Depending on region and supply chain, the exact emulsion source may vary over time.
notes: If consistent results matter, test a roll from the same batch and lab.
